hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations satisfy both entry conditions, or if required exact-size quotes are invalid or unavailable. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate. Unknown extra gas, infrastructure costs, and unreconciled model-invoice costs preclude a full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: Alternative wPONS four-hop size-curve probe
hypotheses.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph contains WETH–USDG–PONS–wPONS–WETH pools, and the available menu includes this route at a 0.005 WETH SIZE_CURVE cap. Hypothesis requiring fresh quotes: this distinct route may exhibit size-dependent after-gas net behavior. Quote every supplied exact size up to the cap and select the greatest current after-gas net; do not scale quote outputs. Enter only if the selected quote meets the 20 bps edge floor and covers the configured gas-safety requirement for two consecutive eligible observations.

hypotheses.failureCondition: Reject at the predeclared ten-observation futility screen if fewer than two consecutive eligible observations meet both the improvement and gas-safety conditions, or if valid quotes are unavailable. A pass is not acceptance or profit. Preserve the original control and require the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate. Unknown extra gas, infrastructure costs, and unreconciled model-invoice costs preclude a full-profit claim.
hypotheses.name: wPONS four-hop quote-improvement probe
hypotheses.rationale: Measured fact: the verified graph includes wPONS-linked pools, and this route/size/family cell is available in the supplied menu. The cohort does not establish a route-specific forward result for it. Hypothesis requiring fresh quotes: a same-size amount-out improvement of at least 100 bps versus the previous consecutive source-valid quote may coincide with a current quote whose net edge covers safety gas. The first source-valid row cannot signal; require both conditions for two consecutive eligible observations.

limitations: The supplied training rows are not forward evidence for either proposed cell; evidenceBlocks identify cohort observations only.
The graph reflects bounded recent factory discovery and exclusions, not complete chain coverage.
Quote opportunities are not fills, trades, inclusion, or earned returns. The ten-observation screen can reject an idea but cannot satisfy the seven-day/1,000-observation acceptance gate.
analysis.summary: The supplied cohort contains 80 observations and 480 quotes, but the provided rows do not establish route-specific results for the proposed cells. The prior wPONS trials recorded no candidate signals in their ten-observation screens; their outcomes do not determine the results of these different route/size/family tests. These are bounded paper experiments, not live changes or claims of profitable fills.
